speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color, such as dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and new onset fatigue with severe itching, could you tell me if you have experienced any jaundice (yellowing of skin or eyes) or recent weight loss? Also, do you have a history of Hepatitis B or C, or have you ever tested positive for Hepatitis A or E?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The presence of scleral icterus confirms jaundice, indicating significant cholestasis. Given your history of autoimmune conditions like ulcerative colitis, this strongly suggests an autoimmune etiology. Before we proceed, I need to confirm if you have noticed any specific skin rash or joint pain recently.
